items.title: Bill Crow interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: a drummer named Dave Jones that we’ve been playing with, a very good drummer.

ctx.x: No kidding? And well that makes sense because in Japan, they love jazz over there, right?

Well this guy called me up. He’s a Japanese writer himself. He’s done short stories in Japanese and he was studying up in Boston somewhere and is fluent in English. But he doesn’t do his own English translations of his own stories, someone else has done those. But he told me that his publisher had made a deal with Oxford for him to do a translation into Japanese and he wanted to do an interview. So on the strength of that I’m finally getting to do a record in my own name, from a Japanese record company that wants…
with here in Westchester — Carmen Leggio and Joe Cohn, Al Cohn’s son, a good guitar player, and a drummer named Dave Jones that we’ve been playing with, a very good drummer.
